package.predicate: A clean environment starts the packaged release broker and completes the user journey (E25) with no development checkout and no undeclared runtime dependency.

lifecycle.predicate: Readiness is distinct from liveness: the broker reports live without a write quorum yet never advertises writable service, and accepted writes drain on shutdown while admission closes explicitly.

drain.predicate: Graceful shutdown drains acknowledged work; every acknowledged byte survives and the admission gate closes explicitly rather than dropping in-flight commits.

metrics.predicate: Bounded operational diagnostics expose per-group leadership, lag, queue pressure, and rejection under a slow follower without leaking secrets.

export.predicate: The supported quiescent logical export (E26) establishes a healthy quiescent cut and produces an artifact that declares its exact cut, preserved identities, and selected scope, with private credentials excluded.

restore.predicate: Restore into empty storage reproduces the declared data and marker ledger through the public API, rewriting only the cluster identity into a fresh local-insecure standalone cluster.

restore-corrupt.predicate: A corrupted or truncated export is refused by restore without publishing any partial state; the destination is never created.

version-fixtures.predicate: Supported storage and format version fixtures (E27) survive restore and startup, and unsupported formats are refused without resetting storage to recover.

secured-package.predicate: The packaged broker honors secured configuration: certificate mounts, log/evidence redaction, and startup refusal match the LS08 security contract.

unsupported.perf_reason: LS09 perf gate (package bytes, startup, idle RSS, diagnostics overhead, restore duration, B4 base/head comparison) is out of scope by operator decision; recorded as SKIPPED, not a waived pass.
unsupported.write_ready_reason: The write_ready < 1s latency target is a perf optimization deferred out of scope.
